text:
mike: deploy-bot flagged the prod rollout. Release v2.1.3 attempted to promote but image tag mismatch vs staging. tagging as 'latest' vs staging pinned -> hold manual review pls

deploy-bot: Release v2.1.3 -> rollout to prod paused by policy: image_tag_unpinned. See /releases/4231 for details :warning:

anna: on it. can we confirm whether this is a chart values issue or the CI image promotion step? staging was pinned by ops last week.

carol: quick check shows prod deployment is referencing chart default: `image.tag: latest`. staging override used `image.tag: stable-20260401` in helm values. I suspect the chart PR reverted the override.

bob: CI changed the promote job to push `:latest` for hotfix branches — I missed the selector. That explains the stray `latest` being available in registry.

dave: rolling prod back to the previous digest now (kubectl rollout undo). keeping canary frozen. here's current state:
```
NAME            READY   UP-TO-DATE   AVAILABLE   AGE
api-service     2/2     2            2           5m
```
kubectl describe shows image: registry.redwood.ai/api:latest on prod, registry.redwood.ai/api@sha256:abcd1234 on stable.

anna: good call. dave, after rollback can you patch values in prod-helm-values to pin `stable-20260401` and open a small PR to keep parity? also need to check KMS flag for secrets because we had a rotation last week.

carol: checking secrets now — prod secret `api-keys` references KMS key version v3, staging has v4 from rotation. That could cause failures if we try to re-deploy keyed artifacts.

bob: CI will need to be updated to push both digest and the stable tag instead of latest. I'll push a patch and run a test promote to staging first.

oncall: flagging for release window decision. This was attempted during the midnight change window (00:30 PST) — per policy manual approvals required for image tag changes. We should document whether this is a hotfix authorized by oncall.

mike: short decision: hold any further automated rollouts until (1) prod helm values pinned, (2) KMS version parity verified or migration planned, (3) CI promotion fixed. If all three done we can re-run the deploy-bot promotion with manual approval.

dave: rollback completed at sha256:abcd1234. created PR #712 to pin prod values and added a note about KMS parity. tagging @deploy-oncall for approval.

deploy-bot: Rollout paused -> state: rolled-back to sha256:abcd1234. Manual re-trigger required after approvals.

anna: thanks. can someone add a short line to the release notes about the image tag policy and the KMS flag change so customers in the change window are aware?

bob: will add to release notes and include the mitigation steps. planning to schedule the fixed rollout for next maintenance window if no regressions in staging. :white_check_mark:

carol: added a quick smoke-check script to verify KMS decrypt after rotation, pushed to infra repo. link: https://git.redwood/infrachecks/commit/9f3

mike: ok, closing this thread once prod pin PR merges and deploy-oncall gives manual go. thanks all :thumbsup:
